info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Cancellation API
info.description: The Payment Cancellation API enables businesses to efficiently manage transaction cancellations by providing a mechanism to invalidate payments. This endpoint allows authorized users to cancel a payment identified by a unique payment ID. Typically used by financial operators and customer support teams, this API facilitates seamless handling of payment disputes and adjustments. It ensures that transactions can be reversed swiftly, improving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel a specified payment identified by its unique payment ID. Ensure that the payment is in a state that allows cancellation before invoking this operation.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling a payment identified by PAY-300045. This operation allows you to initiate the cancellation process for the specified payment, ensuring that necessary details are provided in the request.
